title: The Rise and Fall of the Third Reich
author: William L. Shirer
summary: Journalist William Shirer, who reported from Berlin in the 1930s, narrates Hitler's rise, the Nazi regime and its defeat in the Second World War, drawing on captured German documents.
readIf: you want a long, classic narrative of Nazi Germany by a writer who witnessed part of it.
skipIf: you want recent scholarship or a short introduction, since it is long and dates from 1960.
